ext.name: URLguard – phishing link protection
ext.desc: Warns when a link only pretends to be your bank or a government site. Flags scam ads in search. Free, works locally.
consent.title: Help show how well URLguard works?
consent.text: Once a day, **only numbers** would be sent: how many pages were blocked, how many warnings, how many reports. **No links, no timestamps, no identifiers.** You can turn it off any time.
report.title: Report
report.kindFp: Wrong warning – the page is safe
report.brand: What does it pretend to be? (optional)
report.note: Note, e.g. “came in an SMS about a parcel” (optional)
report.query: Include link parameters (?…) – may contain personal data
report.info: The link goes to a public list on GitHub. After review it is added to the database for all users.
report.ok: Thank you! The report has been sent for review.
report.okGithub: A GitHub form has been opened – check it and press “Submit new issue”.
report.noRepo: The report repository is not configured yet.
log.title: Recent events
settings.title: Settings
settings.stats: Anonymous statistics (numbers only, once a day)
warn.title: Warning! Possible phishing page
warn.stopped: URLguard stopped this page from opening.
warn.didYouMean: You were probably looking for **{brand}**. Official address:
warn.fp: This page is safe – report a mistake
warn.confirm:
Do you really want to open {host}?

Never enter passwords, Smart-ID or card details on this page.
banner.title: URLguard: this page may be fake.
serp.dangerBrand: phishing link – this is not the official {brand} site
serp.warnBrand: suspicious link – not the official {brand} address
reason.feed-listed: The address is on a public phishing list (not yet confirmed).
reason.blocklist: The address is on the list of known phishing sites.
reason.official-embedded: The address contains the official {brand} domain, but the page is actually somewhere else ({domain}).
reason.fake-domain-prefix: The address starts like a {brand} page, but the real domain is {domain}.
reason.homoglyph: The address uses look-alike characters to imitate {brand}.
reason.brand-other-tld: The {brand} name with a different ending (.{tld}) – this is not the official address.
reason.typosquat: The address is very similar to {brand} but differs by a few letters.
reason.brand-in-domain: The address contains the name {brand}, but it is not an official {brand} domain.
reason.brand-in-subdomain: The name {brand} is only in the subdomain – the real domain is {domain}.
reason.ad-impersonation: The ad pretends to be {brand} but leads to {domain}.
reason.mixed-script: The address mixes letters from different alphabets (e.g. Cyrillic and Latin).
reason.suspicious-tld: The domain ending .{tld} is often used for scams.
reason.phishing-words: The address contains words typical for phishing (login, verify, refund, etc.).
reason.free-hosting: The page is on free hosting that scammers often use.
reason.country-hint: "lv", "gov" or similar was added to the address to look more official.
reason.search-mismatch: You searched for {brand}, but this link does not lead to the official {brand} site.
reason.login-on-lookalike: The page asks for login details (password / Smart-ID / personal ID code).
reason.brand-login-unofficial: The page looks like a {brand} login, but it is located at {domain}.
